# TDPdf v2.3.0.0

**Faster with large PDFs, better printing, and many fixes to editing, forms and safety.**

## Pages and viewing

- Large PDFs open at once. Page thumbnails are drawn as you scroll, so a document with thousands of pages no longer waits for all of them.
- Page thumbnails show annotations you have not saved yet.
- Thumbnails no longer turn into "Page N" placeholders after you edit text, undo or redact.
- Switching between Single, Two-page and Continuous keeps your zoom, and zooming from the toolbar or keyboard keeps your place on the page.
- TDPdf reopens where you last closed it, and a tab moved to a new window opens beside the one it came from.
- The footer names the paper size, such as Letter, A4 or ARCH D.
- Back and Forward include jumps made by clicking a thumbnail.

## Page tools

- **Rotate 180°**, also on Ctrl+Shift+U.
- **Extract Pages** takes a page list such as 1-3,7, and can write one PDF, one PDF per page, or one PDF every few pages. Esc cancels and leaves the folder as it was.
- **Delete Pages** takes a typed range in one step.
- Rotating a page also turns the text boxes, signatures and pictures on it.
- Crop with **Apply to all pages** keeps the same margins on pages of a different size.

## Printing

- Very large pages, such as posters and drawings, print instead of coming out blank.
- With Fit to page, a landscape page on portrait paper turns to fill the sheet, and the preview shows it.
- No thin white line at the page edge when a page exactly fills the paper.
- Right-click Print in File Explorer, and printing from other apps, use TDPdf.

## Editing

- Highlights look the same on screen as when saved or printed: the colour tints the paper and the text stays dark.
- Choosing Highlight, Underline or Strikethrough with text already selected marks that text.
- Changing a selected mark's colour, size or font can be undone in one step.
- Editing text in a PDF made by Word keeps its real font, bold and italic.
- A new option lets Enter add a line in a text box, with Ctrl+Enter to save.
- Pictures opened from File Explorer become a new PDF, one page per picture.

## Forms

- Filled form fields keep their border, background colour and text alignment when saved.
- Merging PDFs keeps their form fields.
- Form fields and links line up with the page at every zoom level.

## Security and privacy

- Links open exactly the address TDPdf checked.
- Redaction refuses to save if a redacted word is still in a link, a script or document details you chose to keep.
- Copies TDPdf makes while you edit are deleted as soon as they are replaced.
- Each save of a password-protected PDF gets a new document ID.
- TDPdf loads Windows system files only from the Windows folder.

## Fixes

- In searchable PDFs made with OCR, selecting text follows the scanned lines.
- Dates in saved PDFs use the standard calendar on every Windows language setting.
- Two TDPdf windows no longer overwrite each other's saved signatures.
- Right-click menus taller than the screen scroll.
- Edit Existing Image copies the right part of the page, and the Form tool's buttons show their whole labels.
